The day value 17 makes the DD/MM reading unambiguous, and the batch's ingest date fits 17 Jan, so parsing both formats explicitly gives correct data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4} ') THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM parsed;"}}
